=== Lead photograph (31 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of the left-hand man in a Facebook photograph posted 27 June 2026. The Facebook photo viewer names Adam Drake. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group (group member since 1 July 2009). Gold 98 Lawrenceville, Georgia. The profile lists Lives Buford, Georgia. The woman on the right is Melanie Drake; dest the crop of Adam. A University of Georgia bulldog circular is not the person lead. He posted selling Star Wars CCG shirts and cards. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Adam Drake portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Adam Drake Facebook portrait.jpg]].
